subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment — Next steps & BOM request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@legacybank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment — Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:  

Summary of call:
- Legacy Bank confirmed requirement for a fully air-gapped on-prem deployment for customer-facing inference (no egress to public internet).
- Priority: production latency < 150ms p50 for core routing, multi-DC redundancy, and strict change-control for model updates.
- Preference for on-prem footprint across two data centers (primary + DR) and vendor-approved hardware (you mentioned HPE).

Redwood recommendation (based on initial notes):
- Private on-prem deployment packaged with our Private control plane (customer-managed) + airgap update bundles.
- Initial capacity recommendation: two racks per DC with redundant networking. Final sizing depends on model choice and QPS; see attached draft BOM for baseline configs.

Action items / asks for your team:
1) Confirm number of racks to provision in each DC (we used 2 x DC as working assumption in the attached BOM).
2) Confirm vendor preference / procurement constraints (HPE / preferred SKUs).
3) Share any power/pdu/network constraints (min/max power per rack, available PDUs, whether remote hands available).
4) Identify the security/contact for offline update approvals and procurement lead for SOW.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Dev (SE) will follow up with more detailed hardware options and power estimates (see cc).
- I will share a clean BOM + airgap deployment checklist and an SLA-exception doc for your procurement review.
- Schedule a 90-min SE deep-dive next week to go over workload, model choices, and ops for offline upgrades.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-onprem-bom-v1.pdf (PDF, 310KB)], [Attachment: airgap-deployment-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

Proposed times for SE deep-dive: Thu 8/26 10:00-11:30 PT or Fri 8/27 09:00-10:30 PT — let me know what works.

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment — Post-call recap & next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and attachments. A few clarifications from our side:  

- We do want the two-DC approach. The DCs are Colocation-East (primary) and Colocation-West (DR).
- Procurement note: Legacy Bank prefers HPE gear; however, we can evaluate other OEMs if you provide validated SKUs.
- Power constraints: primary DC has a soft cap of ~14kW per rack; DR site presently has 10kW per rack.
- Security: All software updates must be reviewed by our InfoSec change board. They require an offline update runbook & cryptographically signed artifacts for any model or runtime update.

Can you provide:  
1) Expected GPU density options and corresponding power per rack so we can validate fit with our caps.
2) Offline ops/runbook and how you deliver airgap update bundles (signed images / USB transfer / offline package).
3) BOM in vendor-friendly SKUs (ideally HPE part numbers).

We can bring in our procurement lead for the SOW once we have the spec and rough costs. Happy to do the SE deep-dive Thursday 8/26 at 10:00 PT.

Tom
Tom Hargreaves | Head of AI Infrastructure
Legacy Bank
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@legacybank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment — Hardware options & offline updates

Tom / team —

Thanks for the details. High-level hardware guidance and airgap process below. I'll cover deeper in the SE deep-dive tomorrow.

Hardware density options (typical configs we support):
- Option A (density / higher throughput): 2U servers, each with 4x H100 80GB GPUs (PCIe/PCIe-sx variant). Typical rack: 8 servers -> 32 GPUs per rack. Estimated sustained power draw ~11-13 kW/rack under load (depends on power profile and cooling).
- Option B (balanced): 1U/2U mix with 4x A100 80GB per server; 10 servers per rack -> 40 GPUs/rack. Estimated sustained power draw ~12-14 kW/rack.
- Option C (cost-optimized): Mixed 8x A30/H100-lite nodes for embedding-heavy workloads; lower power ~8-10 kW/rack.

Notes on vendor SKUs: We can provide an HPE-validated BOM with exact part numbers and HPE rack, PDU, and rail options. One caveat: higher-density H100 configs push close to your 14kW cap for a fully populated rack; we should size to the lower of the two DC caps and/or plan for partial-population/thermal headroom.

Airgap / offline update model:
- We deliver signed airgap bundles (tarball + signature) and a corresponding verification utility. Customers can transfer bundles via secure media into an isolated update host.
- Option for a 'staging USB' process for sites without secure staging: we provide pre-signed USB images and a checklist for remote-hands to apply.
- We maintain a runbook with step-by-step verification, rollback steps, and cryptographic checksum verification for each artifact. I attached a short hardware/options sheet and will share the full runbook after the deep-dive.

Attachment: [Attachment: onprem-hardware-options.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

I'll bring sample power/performance numbers and an outline of the offline update flow in the call tomorrow.

—Dev
